description: This file contains classes and functions for interfacing with OpenAI's API, including chat completions, embeddings, image generation, audio speech, and file management. It provides both synchronous and asynchronous methods, handles request/response transformation, error handling, and logging. The code appears to serve as a core component of a larger SDK or client library for interacting with OpenAI services within the 'litellm' project.
